questions.question_english: A Vice-Principal is designated as the PIO of a school. A teacher files an RTI application asking for the authenticated copy of the school’s general cash book for the previous financial year. The Vice-Principal rejects the request stating that financial records are subject to audit and thus exempt from RTI. What is the correct position of law?
options_english: The rejection is valid; official financial records are classified as confidential under GFR rules.

questions.explanation_english: The rejection is invalid; cash books are public records not exempt under Section 8(1). Cash books, financial ledgers, and expenditure records held by public authorities constitute public records under Section 2(f). Ongoing or completed audits do not exempt financial records from disclosure under Section 8(1). Public Information Officers cannot deny access to general cash books requested by employees or citizens.

questions.question_english: Which section of the RTI Act provides the mandate for updating the proactive disclosure publications (manuals) every year?
options_english: Section 4(1)(b)
Section 5(1)
Section 6(3)
Section 7(1)
questions.explanation_english: Section 4(1)(b) Section 4(1)(b) contains the mandatory statutory requirement for public authorities to publish seventeen manuals of proactive information. The concluding mandate of this provision requires public authorities to update these published information manuals every year, ensuring that proactive public disclosures remain accurate, current, and accessible to citizens.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) है: धारा 4(1)(a)। यह उत्तर लोक प्राधिकरण के अभिलेख व्यवस्थित रखने और सूचना का स्वतः प्रकटीकरण करने संबंधी दायित्वों से मेल खाता है।

questions.question_hindi: विद्यालय प्रबंधन समिति (SMC) की दो महीने पहले हुई बैठक के कार्यवृत्त माँगने वाला RTI आवेदन विद्यालय प्रमुख (PIO) को मिलता है। PIO कहता है कि SMC बैठकें आंतरिक मामला हैं और आवेदन अस्वीकार कर देता है। इस निर्णय का कानूनी आकलन क्या है?
options_hindi: हाँ; SMC निजी संस्था है और उसके कार्यवृत्त धारा 8(1)(d) के अंतर्गत छूट प्राप्त हैं।
नहीं; SMC लोक प्राधिकरण का भाग है और उसके कार्यवृत्त धारा 4 के अनुसार प्रकट किए जाने चाहिए।
हाँ; SMC के कार्यवृत्त स्वतः गोपनीय होते हैं और प्रकट नहीं किए जा सकते।
नहीं; कार्यवृत्त केवल सूचना आयोग की अनुमति के बाद प्रकट किए जा सकते हैं।
questions.question_english: A School Head acting as PIO rejects an RTI request for minutes of a School Management Committee (SMC) meeting held two months earlier, saying SMC meetings are internal affairs. Under the RTI Act and Directorate of Education norms, is this decision legally sound?
options_english: Yes; SMCs are private bodies and their minutes are exempt under Section 8(1)(d).
No; SMCs form part of the public authority and minutes should be disclosed under Section 4.
Yes; SMC minutes are confidential by default and cannot be disclosed.
No; minutes may be disclosed only after approval by the Information Commission.
questions.explanation_english: No, SMCs are part of the public authority, and minutes should be disclosed under Section 4. School Management Committees established in government and aided schools under educational statutes form an integral part of the public authority. Minutes of their proceedings record public administrative decisions affecting school governance and operations. These records are subject to disclosure under Section 4 and Section 6, making outright rejection based on claims of private internal affairs legally untenable.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) है: नहीं; SMC लोक प्राधिकरण का भाग है और उसके कार्यवृत्त धारा 4 के अनुसार प्रकट किए जाने चाहिए। यह उत्तर लोक प्राधिकरण के अभिलेख व्यवस्थित रखने और सूचना का स्वतः प्रकटीकरण करने संबंधी दायित्वों से मेल खाता है।
key_facts: Correct option (English): No; SMCs form part of the public authority and minutes should be disclosed under Section 4.

questions.question_english: Under the Right to Information Act, the term “State Public Information Officer” includes:
options_english: Exclusively the administrative head of the government department
Exclusively the elected representatives serving in the State Legislative Assembly
The constitutional Governor presiding over the State
Every officer designated under Section 5(1) or 5(2)
questions.explanation_english: Every officer designated under Section 5(1) or 5(2) Section 2(m) defines a State Public Information Officer as any officer designated by a public authority under Section 5(1) or Assistant Public Information Officer designated under Section 5(2). It includes all designated departmental officers authorized to receive and process RTI applications across state administrative departments and public institutions.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (D) है: धारा 5(1) या 5(2) के अंतर्गत नामित राज्य लोक सूचना अधिकारी। स्रोत में दी गई व्याख्या और संबंधित वैधानिक प्रावधान इस विकल्प का समर्थन करते हैं।

questions.question_hindi:
सूचना का अधिकार अधिनियम की धारा 2(j) में दिए गए अधिकारों के संबंध में इन कथनों पर विचार करें:
I. कार्यों, दस्तावेज़ों और अभिलेखों का निरीक्षण।
II. दस्तावेज़ों के नोट्स, उद्धरण या प्रमाणित प्रतियाँ लेना।
III. सामग्री के प्रमाणित नमूने लेना।
IV. गलती करने वाले लोक सेवक के विरुद्ध अनुशासनात्मक कार्रवाई की माँग करना। कौन-से कथन सही हैं?
questions.question_english:
Review the following statement(s) regarding the rights included under Section 2(j) of the RTI Act:
I. Inspect works, documents, and records
II. Take notes, extracts, or certified copies of documents
III. Take certified samples of material
IV. Demand disciplinary action against an erring public servant Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
options_english: I and II only
I, II, and III only
II, III, and IV only
I, II, III, and IV
questions.explanation_english: I, II, and III only Section 2(j) defines the right to information held by or under the control of any public authority. It explicitly encompasses inspecting works, documents, and records; taking notes, extracts, or certified copies; and taking certified samples of material. Demanding disciplinary proceedings against individual public servants is not part of this definition, as it constitutes administrative action.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) है: केवल I, II और III। स्रोत की व्याख्या अधिनियम में दी गई परिभाषा और सूचना तक पहुँच के दायरे पर आधारित है।
key_facts: Correct option (English): I, II, and III only

questions.question_english: A State Chief Information Commissioner shall be appointed by the Governor on the recommendation of a committee consisting of:
options_english: The State Governor, Chief Minister, and the serving Chief Justice of the High Court
Chief Minister, Leader of Opposition in Assembly, and a nominated Cabinet Minister
The Chief Minister, Chief Secretary to Government, and the State Home Minister
The Chief Justice of the High Court, Leader of Opposition, and State Election Commissioner
questions.explanation_english: Chief Minister, Leader of Opposition in Assembly, and a nominated Cabinet Minister Section 15(3) specifies the selection committee that recommends appointments for State Chief Information Commissioners and State Information Commissioners. The committee comprises the Chief Minister as Chairperson, the Leader of Opposition in the Legislative Assembly, and a State Cabinet Minister nominated by the Chief Minister for formal recommendation to the Governor.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) है: प्रधानमंत्री, लोकसभा अध्यक्ष और भारत के मुख्य न्यायाधीश। स्रोत की व्याख्या संबंधित सूचना आयोग की शक्तियों, नियुक्ति-प्रक्रिया या अपील-संबंधी वैधानिक व्यवस्था पर आधारित है।
key_facts: Correct option (English): Chief Minister, Leader of Opposition in Assembly, and a nominated Cabinet Minister

questions.question_english: What is the minimum age prescribed in the RTI Act for a citizen to file an RTI application?
options_english: Minimum age of 14 years explicitly required
Minimum age of 18 years explicitly required
Minimum age of 21 years explicitly required
No minimum age is prescribed in the Act
questions.explanation_english: No minimum age is prescribed in the Act The Right to Information Act, 2005 does not prescribe any minimum age requirement for submitting an information application. Section 3 broadly provides that all citizens shall have the right to information, enabling minor students to submit formal requests for educational or official records without needing adult representation or age verification.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (D) है: अधिनियम में कोई न्यूनतम आयु निर्धारित नहीं है। स्रोत की व्याख्या RTI आवेदन, उसे संबंधित प्राधिकरण तक पहुँचाने और आवेदक की आवश्यकताओं से संबंधित प्रक्रिया पर आधारित है।

questions.question_english: In school administration, the identity of a student who acted as a whistleblower to report a serious bullying incident to the Principal is sought by the parents of the accused student through RTI. Which section firmly protects the disclosure of the whistleblower’s identity?
options_english: Section 8(1)(a)
Section 8(1)(c)
Section 8(1)(g)
Section 8(1)(i)
questions.explanation_english: Section 8(1)(g) Section 8(1)(g) exempts disclosing information that would reveal the identity of an informant who provided assistance in confidence. Protecting a student whistleblower who reported bullying prevents potential retaliation and physical endangerment. Public Information Officers must withhold informant identities to preserve safety under this statutory exemption clause.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) है: धारा 8(1)(g) – जीवन या शारीरिक सुरक्षा को खतरे में डालने वाली सूचना/स्रोत की पहचान। स्रोत की व्याख्या संबंधित छूट-प्रावधान, गोपनीयता, तीसरे पक्ष के अधिकार या जनहित के परीक्षण पर आधारित है।
